sql.workQueue.getWorkQueues: select wqt.id as work_queue_type_id, wqt.work_queue_type, wqt.work_queue_category_id, wqc.color, (select count(*) from flow.project p inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.project_id = p.id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.process_step_work_queue_type pswqt on pswqt.process_step_id = ps.id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = pps.user_position_id left join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where wqt.id = pswqt.work_queue_type_id and case when :isParent then true else ps.company_id = :companyId end and case when :unassigned is true then pps.user_position_id is null when :unassigned is not true and :userPositionId::int is not null then pps.user_position_id = :userPositionId else true end and cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = :processStepStatusTypeId ) as work_queue_count from flow.work_queue_type wqt inner join flow.work_queue_category wqc on wqc.id = wqt.work_queue_category_id where case when :workQueueCategoryId::int is not null then wqt.work_queue_category_id = :workQueueCategoryId else true end and wqt.company_id = :parentCompanyId and wqt.archived is not true order by wqc.display_order, wqt.display_order
sql.workQueue.getProcessStepsByTypeId: select ps.id as process_step_id, p.project_name, pps.id as project_process_step_id, wqt.work_queue_type, pps.project_id, ps.process_step_name, p.contact_id, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as owner, coalesce(pps.date_modified, pps.date_created) as last_updated, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(owningPositions))) FROM ( SELECT pspop.id, pspop.process_step_process_id as "processStepProcessId", pspop.position_id as "positionId", pspop.archived FROM flow.process_step_process_owning_position pspop inner join flow.process_step_process psp on psp.id = pspop.process_step_process_id WHERE psp.process_step_id = ps.id and pspop.archived is not true) owningPositions), '[]') AS "owningPositions", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(activeProcessSteps))) FROM ( select ps2.process_step_name as "processStepName", ps2.id as "processStepId" from flow.project_process_step pps2 inner join flow.process_step ps2 on ps2.id = pps2.process_step_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst2 on cpsst2.id = pps2.company_process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst2 on psst2.id = cpsst2.process_step_status_type_id where pps2.project_id = p.id and cpsst2.id = 1 and pps2.archived is not true and pps2.id != pps.id order by ps2.process_step_name) activeProcessSteps), '[]') AS "activeProcessSteps" from flow.project p inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.project_id = p.id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.process_step_work_queue_type pswqt on pswqt.process_step_id = ps.id inner join flow.work_queue_type wqt on wqt.id = pswqt.work_queue_type_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = pps.user_position_id left join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where pswqt.work_queue_type_id = :workQueueTypeId and case when :isParent then true else ps.company_id = :companyId end and case when :unassigned is true then pps.user_position_id is null when :unassigned is not true and :userPositionId::int is not null then pps.user_position_id = :userPositionId else true end and cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = :processStepStatusTypeId order by last_updated;
sql.workQueue.getWorkQueueOwners: select distinct pps.user_position_id, up.user_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name from flow.project_process_step pps inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.user_position up on up.id = pps.user_position_id inner join flow."user" u on u.id = up.user_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id where case when :isParent then array[ps.company_id] <@ ( select array(select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int))) else ps.company_id = :companyId end and cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = :processStepStatusTypeId order by first_name, last_name
